description: G-buffer smoke (developer build: -Asi Release\ApexRadiance.asi), GB-01 to GB-03: the capability line, camera motion vectors, the scene's extra render targets written by the ps_3_0 and ps_2_x copies and the colour-coded views. Each variant is one view: one F8 picture with a still camera, then one minute of camera pan. -AB runs the six views in the order list; without it the motion view runs. Pass: no crash, the [GBuffer] lines of the variant, a Scene line with patched draws and no failed bind, no shader or target error. Read after the run: the pictures (albedo: objects in their texture colour; normal: colours follow the surface; material and class: flat colours per object; unwritten: red where no copy wrote; walls and floors should now be written, the Scene line's ps2= and replaced= counts above 0 with Night Lighting on), the UI absent from every view, no trails behind glass or particles.
